items.title: yaad aayi na tumhe fatima soughra baba
items.body:
yaad aayi na tumhe fatima soughra baba
karbala jaake mujhe bhool gaye kya baba
hurf hurf iska badi ghour se padhna baba
kaampte hatho se likhi hu ye naama baba
<<DIVIDER>>
haaye kis kis ki shikaayat karu allah allah
ek qat bhi to kisi ne nahi lika baba
kya likha haal ajab haal hai tap se mera
aise jeene se hai behtar mera marna baba
<<DIVIDER>>
zouf itna hai ke chalti hu to gir jaati hu
sar me chakkar hai mere haath me resha baba
dekh kar haal mera roti hai ghurbat meri
hichki jab aati hai chillaati hu baba baba
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai akbar ko bhijaane ka kiya tha wada
jald bhijwaao khuda ke lie baba baba
bhai qasim ki mere ho gayi hogi shadi
meri jaanib se mubaarak unhe kehna baba
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaar karne meri jaanib se ali asghar ko
yaad aata hai wo chota mera bhayya baba

items.title: Yu sakina ne pukaara
items.body:
Yu sakina ne pukaara ae mere baba Hussain
Ab nahi koi hamaara ae mere baba Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr baali khenchta hai, kaan se aajaiye
Aayiye ab to khudaara ae mere baba Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Raat hoti hai barasti , Oos sar par dekhiye
hai phata kurta hamara ae mere baba Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Naatawaa'n hai bediyaa'n hai, deejiye aakar zara
Bhai aabid ko sahaara ae mere baba Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Baandh kar rassi gale me, khainchta hai shirmr jab
Maine ammu ko pukaara ae mere baba Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Jal gaye qaime lute hum, chaadarei'n cheeni gayi
ab nahi jeena gawaara ae mere baba Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hil gaya arshe mo'alla laash tharrayi taqi
jab sab sakina ne pukara ae mere baba Hussain

items.title: Ghabraaegi Zainab dukh payegi Zainab
items.body:
Ghabraaegi Zainab dukh payegi Zainab
Bhaiyya tumhe ghar jaake kahan payegi Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisa yeh bhara ghar huva barbaad ilaahi kya aae tabaahi
Ab isko na aabaad kabhi payegi Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Phat jayega bas dekhte hi ghar ko kaleja yaad aaoge bhaiyya
Dil dhoondhega tumko toh kahaan payegi Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Bin bachhon ke kehlaayi toh kehlaayi main laikin yeh
kaise ho mumkin
Bin bhai ke kehlaayi toh marjayegi Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Poochenge joh sab loug ke baazu ko huva kya yeh neel hae kaisa
Kis kis ko nishan rassi ke dikhlaegi Zainab

items.title: Abid ghareeb beykas-o-naachaar margaya
items.body:
Abid ghareeb beykas-o-naachaar margaya
Saadaath khaak uddaayein kay Sardaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Saayaa rahaa saroun pa na chawthay Imam ka
Zehra ki jaan Hussain ka dildaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaanton pa kheinchtey thay jisey raahey Shaam mein
Woh saarbaan-e-Ithrath-e-Athaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Shammey mazaarey Panjetan-e-Paak bhujj gayee
Saidaaniyoun ka haaye parasthaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Baanu ka chaand zeir-e-zameen haaye chhupp gaya
Faaqaa kasho Ghareeb Dilafgaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Beti Hasan ki hogayi beywaa hazaar haif
Haider ka pothaa aashiq-e-Ghaffaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Rothaa rahaa jo baap ko chaalees saal takh
Woh aaj Shaahey deen ka Azadaar margaya
Bin baap kay layeen ney Baqar ko kardiyaa
Chauthaa Wasee-e-Ahmad-e-Mukhtaar margaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyunkar Shaoor khaak uddaaoon na aaj mai
Mai jiski nasl sey hoon woh sardaar margaya

items.title: muslim ka khoon haye
items.body:
Muslim ka qoon haaye musalmaa’n bahaate hai
Zahra o Mustafa o Ali ko rulaate hai
Mushkil kusha ho jis ka chacha usko ahle shaam
Be jurm haaye tauqo salaasal pinhaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tharra raha hai qabr me laasha aqeel ka
Muslim ko baam par se zamee’n par giraate hai
Muslim ki beti kehti hai ro kar Hussain se
Ae ammu jaan baba bohot yaad aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh sar pa haath pher rahe hai yateem ke
Behlaate hai manaate hai lo lo pinhaate hai
Bacho ka girya dekh nahi’n sakte shaahedee’n
Rote hai wo to shaah bhi aansu bahaate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Afsos karbala me sakina ko ahle shaam
Royi to aur ghurkiyaa’n dekar rulaate hai
Wo yu’n dilaasa dete hai binte Hussain ko
Sar shaah ka yateem to laakar dikhaate hai

items.title: Boley beti se sibtey payambar
items.body:
Boley beti se sibtey payambar
baad mere na rona Sakina
Zid na karna mujhe yaad karke,
ma ki godhi mein sona Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum bahut door jayenge bibi
ab na soorath dikhaenge bibi
Hum agar yaad aaenge bibi
tum na bechain hona Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri furqat mein girya kare gar
ya unhein yaad aajaye Asghar
Maa ko ronay na dena tu dilbar
moonh pah moonh rakh kay sona Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Bibi aaye tumhein gar meri yaad
roke karna na tum zaaro faryaad
Varna tum par bahut hogi bedaad
maar khana na rona Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr kodon se degah azeeyath
aur tamaachon se woh bay hameeyat
Tumko degah yateemi mein zehmat
jaan apni na khona Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad mere tu dukhyari hogi
tujh ko eeza meri pyari hogi
Zindagi phir tujhe bhaari hogi
tujhko hai qaid hona Sakina
Hum to soyenge maabaine maqtal
yaad mein meri tum hogi bekal
Paaogi mera seena kahan kal
khaak ab hae bichona Sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash se meri jab tum lipat kar
ro-ogi aye meri jaane dukhtar
Koday maarega Shimr-e badh akhtar
hai yeh sub tumko sehna Sakina

items.title: Rokay kehti thi maadar kal na jaaney kya hoga
items.body:
Rokay kehti thi maadar kal na jaaney kya hoga
Aye Meray Ali Akbar kal na jaaney kya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri mannathoun waale meri goadh ke paaley
Aye meray mahey anwar kal na jaaney kya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Maen sanwaarti toh hoon aaj teri zulfoun ko
Sounchti hoon reh reh kar kal na jaaney kya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj meray dil mai hai teray biyaaha ka armaan
Aye shabihey Paighamber kal na jaaney kya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Shabihey Paighamber hai yeh jaanthey hain sab
Phir bhi aye Ali Akbar kal na jaaney kya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Raat bhar ki mehmaan hai teri chaand si soorath
Dekhloon main jee bharkar kal na jaaney kya hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye sayeed ek shab ki sheh ney paayi hai mohlath
Aaj hi hai yeh mehshar kal na jaaney kya hoga
